claims.claim: Thompson published Thatcher illusion in 1980

claims.notes: Describe tested task not diagnostic ability

claims.claim: STS response was orientation-dependent in fMRI adaptation study
claims.notes: Correlate, not causation or mind-reading

claims.claim: Expression recognition and perceived grotesqueness are separate tasks
claims.notes: S04 abstract only
